reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: The reconstruction omits report submission and cancellation capabilities.

decisions.rationale: The source supports complete reporting, including submission and cancellation; correct the parent's responsibility to match.
decisions.outcome_justification: Citizen submits, tracks, and interacts with urban issue reports, receiving real-time notifications and public visibility of report status and location.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: The reconstruction omits report visibility on the interactive map.

decisions.rationale: The source supports public report visibility; correct the parent's outcome to match.
decisions.outcome_justification: Citizens access dual-view public reports — an interactive map with geolocation markers and a summary table with metadata — both supporting dynamic filtering and sorting.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: The reconstruction omits report cancellation and following other users' reports.

decisions.rationale: The source supports complete real-time communication; correct the parent's responsibility to match.
decisions.outcome_justification: Citizen receives multi-channel notifications and direct interactions regarding their own and others' submitted reports, including real-time platform alerts, email updates, direct messages from staff, chatbot interactions, and follow-based notifications for other reports.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: The reconstruction omits report rejection and manual updates for external entities.

decisions.rationale: The source supports complete review and approval; correct the parent's responsibility to match.
decisions.outcome_justification: Enable citizen report review and decision-making with mandatory justification for rejection by organization office staff, and manage technical reports' lifecycle by assigning them to responsible parties.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: The reconstruction omits report assignment to external companies and manual updates for external entities.

decisions.rationale: The source supports complete technical report management; correct the parent's responsibility to match.
decisions.outcome_justification: Manage the lifecycle of technical reports by assigning them to responsible parties, tracking their status through defined phases (In Progress, Work in Progress, Suspended, Rejected, Resolved), and handling manual updates for external entities without system access.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: The reconstruction omits private system performance analytics.

decisions.rationale: The source supports comprehensive oversight; correct the parent's outcome to match.
decisions.outcome_justification: Enable Municipal Administrator to view both public report statistics and private system performance analytics for comprehensive oversight of report trends and infrastructure health.
